job.title: Machine Line Operator
job.description:
MACHINE LINE OPERATOR

We are chasing reliable and motivated Line Operators to join a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This role is ideal for candidates with machine operating experience who enjoy hands-on work and working within a team-focused production environment.
 
BENEFITS
  • Above award pay rates with guaranteed overtime each week
  • Stable, ongoing full-time hours
  • Monday to Friday roster - no weekend work
  • Day Shift – 5:45am – 3:15pm
  • Supportive team environment within a structured manufacturing setting
  • Ongoing training and development opportunities for career progression
  • On-site Café with discounted meal options 
 
TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Operating and maintaining zinc plating machinery
  • Loading and unloading flight bars
  • Conducting routine quality checks on finished parts
  • Reading job instructions and part numbers via computer systems
  • General machine cleaning and housekeeping
  • Following workplace safety and quality procedures
 
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
  • Previous machine operating or production experience
  • Comfortable using computers and reading job information
  • Strong attention to detail and quality standards
  • Reliable with a good work ethic
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Current driver's licence and reliable transport (essential)
 
ABOUT THE COMPANY
 
A trusted, long-standing manufacturer with a large production site in Northern Gold Coast, supplying high-quality products across Australia and growing internationally. They offer a safe, quality-driven environment with a strong focus on customer service.

job.title: Production Worker with Forklift
job.description:
PRODUCTION OPERATOR WITH FORKLIFT | HEMMANT

Join one of Australia's leading poultry producers and play an important role in the manufacture of high-quality animal feed. This hands-on role combines forklift operation, material handling and production support, making it ideal for someone who enjoys variety and working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

If you're an experienced forklift operator looking for secure, ongoing employment with excellent earning potential, we'd love to hear from you.

BENEFITS
  • Immediate start available
  • Guaranteed full-time hours
  • Above award casual rates of $36-$44 per hour (including shift allowances)
  • Regular overtime and public holiday work available
  • Rotating day and afternoon roster for improved work-life balance
  • Full on-the-job training provided
  • On-site parking
  • Stable, long-term opportunity with a well-established employer
TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Operate forklifts to safely move raw materials and finished products
  • Load and unload trucks and transport materials throughout the site
  • Assist with batching, mixing and packaging of animal feed
  • Support production during equipment changeovers and shutdowns
  • Work closely with production, maintenance and logistics teams
  • Maintain a clean, safe and organised work area
  • Follow all workplace safety and quality procedures
SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
  • Current LF Forklift Licence is required
  • Minimum 12 months' experience in manufacturing, production or warehouse environments
  • Experience operating forklifts in a fast-paced workplace
  • Good time management and ability to prioritise tasks
  • Basic mechanical aptitude and confidence working around machinery
  • Physically fit and comfortable working indoors and outdoors
  • Strong communication skills and commitment to workplace safety
  • Feed mill or food manufacturing experience is advantageous but not essential
HOW TO APPLY
